capabilities: Adopt animated pixel pets and 40 Stardew Valley villagers with signature animations
Display companions in a dockable side panel or a full-window overlay on desktop and mobile
Generate in-character AI dialogue commenting on the current note
Let villagers remember durable facts about the user and start conversations with each other
Schedule daily villager visits with a rotating roster of up to six
disambiguation: Not a Stardew Valley game, wiki, or note-content tool; it only displays animated characters in the Obsidian workspace.
extras: Fan project not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe or Obsidian; all Stardew art belongs to ConcernedApe. AI features are optional — pets and villagers work without any API key. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer. Can also be installed via BRAT or manually.
problem: Obsidian's workspace is static and text-focused; it offers no ambient, decorative companions to make long writing sessions feel less sterile.

relations.evidence: stardew-pet-farm — the original Stardew pet concept and sprites
vscode-pets — the original "pets in your editor" idea

requires.name: DeepSeek or other OpenAI-compatible API key
Local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM)

summary: Workspace companion plugin that shows animated pixel pets and 40 Stardew Valley villagers that wander, chat with AI, and react to your notes.
